messages.subject: Mining & Metals Executive | ESG, Stakeholder and External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kevin,

Koncert's mining and metals search focus aligns closely with my background in responsible mining leadership. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where mining performance must align with regulators, communities and strategic stakeholders. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
